faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: Estimates on new systems are free. Service calls have a flat diagnostic fee that's applied to the repair if you have us do the work.

faqs.q: How fast can you get here?
faqs.a: Same-day service is usually available for no-heat and no-cool calls. Call and we'll give you a real window.
If the system is over 12 to 15 years old and the repair is a big one, replacement often pays for itself in efficiency. We'll give you both numbers and let you decide.
Yes, on new systems, with approval in minutes.
